title: Settlement Lag Policy
text: Settlements for domestic transactions typically settle within T+2 business days from the payment authorization date. Transactions authorized on Fridays or preceding bank holidays may settle up to T+4 business days later. Any settlement delayed beyond T+5 business days requires formal escalation and must not be automatically assumed matched without positive bank confirmation.

title: UPI Payment Fee Policy
text: Peer-to-Merchant UPI transactions carry a 0.0% processing fee for transaction amounts under INR 2,000. For transactions exceeding INR 2,000 or prepaid payment instrument (PPI) wallets, a merchant interchange fee between 0.5% and 1.1% is deducted directly from the gross payout.

title: Credit & Debit Card Fee Policy
text: Domestic card processing fees are deducted at source from the gross payment before net payout is disbursed to the settlement account. Standard card processing fees range from 1.5% to 2.5% (typically 2.0% for Visa/Mastercard, plus flat INR 5.00-15.00 gateway fee). The net settlement amount equals gross payment minus fee.

title: Netbanking and Digital Wallet Policy
text: Netbanking transactions incur a flat fee between INR 10.00 and 1.5% of gross transaction value. Digital wallet payouts incur an interchange fee between 1.2% and 2.0%. Fee deductions must balance to the exact penny: gross_amount - fee = net_settlement.

title: Conflicting Duplicate Candidate Policy
text: When two or more distinct settlement records match a single payment with identical monetary amounts and references within the same settlement date window, autonomous auto-resolution is strictly prohibited. The reconciliation engine and AI agents must escalate the case to the Human Review Queue under reason code AMBIGUOUS_DUPLICATE.

title: Partial Settlement and Reserve Policy
text: Payment gateway reserves or rolling holdbacks may result in partial payouts (e.g. 70% to 90% of gross value). Partial settlements must be marked as PARTIAL_SETTLED and flagged for human operator verification rather than being force-matched or written off as fee discrepancies.

title: Refund and Chargeback Deductions
text: Customer refunds and chargebacks reduce the settlement payout. A refund payout reflects a negative adjustment or net deduction of the original gross amount plus a reversal processing fee of INR 15.00. Reconcile refund records by cross-referencing order return receipts.
